appfunction.description: Search this household stash. Pass query as the words to match, such as a name, a place, or expired. Returns a short summary and one line per item. A quantity of zero is still in the stash until the person deletes it.
List items that are expired or inside the household warning window. Takes no parameters. Returns a short summary and one line per item.
Add one named item to the stash. name is required. quantity is optional, from 1 to 999, and defaults to 1. place is an optional place name. Nutrition is left blank. Returns a short confirmation.
Read the shopping list: items below their keep-at-least amount, plus names added by hand. Takes no parameters.
Add a name to the shopping list. name is required. Returns a short confirmation.
